subject: act
title: ACT.------INFO.TRNS.
description: First of two diagrams in ALT(FT)II-21 — the section closing with Braxton's call: 'There is now a need to combat the mis-information surrounding world information — and we can no longer wait for western scholars and definers to discover universality and bail us out of this dilemma — because these people are part of the problem. The time to act is now (and it was "now" two thousand years ago).' The crossing diagrams how action structurally meets information-transition at the universal-information scale: ACT (action — the actual move-now action the prose names) is crossed with INFO-TRNS (information transition — the partner-axis converting action into the western definers' working information). ACT sits centrally with the subject-arrow; JR-DY (junior dynamic) rises above and MT-INFO (meta-information) at upper-left with RT-DY (reality dynamics) and INFO-TRNS at top as the upper chain. DOC (documentation) anchors the right margin as the partner-side's upper output. CUL-AF-H (cultural-affinity host) sits at right of ACT, with POL-P (political particulars) below as the partner-side downward output. C-FO-ACT (central focused activism) at the left, with DEC (decision) at lower-left and C-INFO (central information) below as the subject-side downward chain. POL-DY (political dynamics) hangs at the bottom-center as the bridging-axis downward terminus. Structural argument: when action is crossed with information-transition, the upper chain JR-DY → MT-INFO → RT-DY → INFO-TRNS → DOC is the *western definers' route* — junior-dynamic routes through meta-information and reality-dynamics into the partner-axis's information-transition, finally producing documentation. This is exactly what the prose names: the route through which 'mis-information surrounding world information' gets manufactured. The subject's C-FO-ACT → DEC → C-INFO chain on the left is what action produces alone — central-focused-activism routes through decision into central-information without ever reaching the partner-axis. CUL-AF-H → POL-P is the partner-side bottom — cultural-affinity-host produces political-particulars. POL-DY at the bottom-center is the bridging terminus. The 'time to act is now' is structurally the call to hold the C-FO-ACT diagonal back across into RT-DY without letting JR-DY's upper chain capture it first — Braxton's structural insistence that action precedes the western definers' chain rather than waiting on it.
